title: Fashion Outfit Generation via Unified Sequential Composition Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.13888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The task of synthesizing stylistically coherent fashion outfits from massive item libraries, known as fashion outfit generation, remains a non-trivial challenge, primarily due to the non-monotonic and implicit nature of aesthetic compatibility, coupled with the exponentially large combinatorial search space. In this paper, we formalize this task as Constrained Ensemble Generation (CEG) and model it as a finite-horizon deterministic Markov Decision Process. To address CEG in fashion, we propose the Unified Sequential Composition Model (USCM), which jointly models set-level compatibility and latent composition intents. Guided by USCM's learned priors, a Latent Expansion Monte Carlo Tree Search (LE-MCTS) mechanism is proposed to handle item retrieval during composition, balancing local aesthetic synergy with global structural balance. translated_title: 通过统一序列组合模型进行时尚穿搭生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13888v1 公告类型：新 摘要：从大规模商品库中合成风格协调的时尚穿搭任务，被称为时尚穿搭生成，仍然是一个非平凡的挑战，主要由于美学兼容性的非单调和隐含特性，以及指数级增长组合搜索空间。在本文中，我们将此任务形式化为约束集合生成（CEG），并将其建模为有限时域确定性马尔可夫决策过程。为了解决时尚领域的CEG，我们提出了统一序列组合模型（USCM），该模型联合建模集合级兼容性和潜在组合意图。在USCM学习先验的指导下，我们提出了一种潜在扩展蒙特卡洛树搜索（LE-MCTS）机制，用于处理组合过程中的商品检索，平衡局部美学协同与全局结构平衡。在Polyvore Outfits数据集上的广泛实验，以及在iFashion上的零样本评估，验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种统一序列组合模型结合潜在扩展蒙特卡洛树搜索的方法，有效解决了时尚穿搭生成中的美学兼容性和组合搜索难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Unified Sequential Composition Model combined with Latent Expansion Monte Carlo Tree Search to effectively address aesthetic compatibility and combinatorial search challenges in fashion outfit generation.
